documentary_provenance.basis: author-supplied primary-source citation and explicit documentary reconciliation

nominal_spatial_scale.raster_crosscheck_relation: Compatible with the documented nominal 1.40 micrometres per pixel; the raster interval is not a statistical confidence interval.

physical_orientation.reason: Existing G1 metadata identify condition names only; no traceable physical vectors in native pixel coordinates were established.

printed_bar_candidate.uncertainty_kind: conservative endpoint/threshold/row/time bound; not a statistical confidence interval

registration_interpretation: Method v1 produced insufficient evidence before transformation-class selection. Historical ROI/registration dependency wording means no certified fit was obtained, not that an admissible physical transformation cannot exist.

roi.reason: No admissible modality-to-canonical transforms; an all-modalities, all-five-instants common support rectangle cannot be certified. No fallback to full-frame or dimensions-only ROI.

scale.reason: Nominal X/Y pixel sizes are documented at 1.40 micrometres per pixel by the author-supplied source citation. Complete metrological uncertainty and registration/ROI prerequisites remain unresolved; physical coordinate conversion is not authorized.

discretization.applies_to: one native coordinate axis; not a propagated two-point or physical-distance uncertainty
discretization.method: Analytical per-axis standard uncertainty for an explicitly assumed uniform quantization error on [-0.5,+0.5] pixel: u=1/sqrt(12). This is a discretization model, not an experimental residual or total uncertainty.

registration.reason: Both native-to-canonical modality registrations lack an admissible fit; no validated registration residual can be propagated.

roi.reason: A canonical ROI has not been certified because transforms, full shared support and physical orientation are unresolved; boundary sensitivity cannot be evaluated.

scale.reason: Nominal X/Y sampling of 1.40 micrometres per pixel is documented. The preserved raster sensitivity interval is not a statistical confidence interval or a complete metrological uncertainty certificate.

temporal.reason: No admissible registration parameters exist for assessing temporal variation across the five frozen instants. Constant bar lengths in three estimation frames do not establish registration stability.
